name: Colorado Trail Day 10: Cottonwood Pass + Tincup Pass
gear: New Balance Hierro v8  Shadow Grey
description: Ooph. One of the rougher days I've had in the backcountry. Snowed for several hours in the morning. Most of which I was between 12 and 13 thousand feet for on the Continental divide ridge. Very few views to speak of due to whiteout.  Had to put away poles to keep my hands in my pockets. It let up for a couple hours but then picked up as a snow thunderstorm just as I was about to tackle the next pass. I ran back down the trail and encouraged a few other hikers to shelter below treeline with me. Spent about 20 minutes in hail/snow crouched in the lightning position on my sleeping pad. Wish I had some photos because it was very dramatic but was more focused on staying safe. Then had another couple hours break before the snow returned as I tried to make camp. Very wet and cold night.
